09/22/2006:  Station Maintenance: (bn): 
 
             - Power Adjustments (hopefully will correct power issues 
               that recently introduced faulty/missing data at stations 
               such as at Fremont):  [Work done: ~ 12:30] 
 
               - Cell-IP modem now uses external solid-state relay 
                 (SW12) instead of internal switched circuit. 
    
               - solid-state relay (SW) connected to terminals inside 
                 the power supply instead of the wiring panel. 
 
               - datalogger battery replaced.

04/08/2002:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
             - Daylight Savings Time Started on Day=97, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (forward)  
               from Day=97, Time=200 through Day=97, Time=410. 
 
 
10/30/2001:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
             - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=301, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
               from Day=301, Time=200 through Day=301, Time=610. 
 
 
10/30/2000:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
                 
             - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=303, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
               from Day=303, Time=200 through Day=304, Time=1230. 
               Only Observation Times were modified, not times of 
               Maxs and Mins.  Users will need to take that into 
               consideration when using this data. 
 
 
02/07/2000:  Fixed old data to reflect recent change in "mawn1a" 
             program - padded missing values to 5-minute data. 
 
 
02/05/2000:  Updated "mawn1a" to include Wind Speed, Air Temp, 
             and Relative Humidity in 5-minute data. 
 
 
08/07/1999:  Hart station updated - (mawn1a).
